keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 1478-1900: Ankole as the 16,104 km2 of the infobox. The page dates no growth: it puts the initial core 'in Isingiro, 20 km south of Mbarara' and gives the infobox area without a year. The shape drawn (about 12,000 km2, ratio 0.75) is the whole kingdom from the start, which overstates the early state; a gap-filler should date the expansion.

notes:
New state (Cliopatria has no Ankole row). One page: Ankole (Nkore). It gives the infobox (Ruhinda 1478, capital Mbarara, area 16,104 km2), the reign table and the 1901 incorporation, and nothing on wars, counties or expansion.

Disagreements: the establishment 1478 (infobox) or Ruhinda's reign c. 1430-1446 (table); the Protectorate 1896 (reign note) or 25 October 1901 (text and infobox). Not on the page: wars with Karagwe, Buganda, Rwanda or Bunyoro, the counties of Kabula, Buhweju and Bunyaruguru (Buhweju appears only as a modern district), the annexation of Mpororo (Rwampara County 'previously part of the Mpororo kingdom', undated), the 1894 treaty. A kingdom of Mpororo preceded Ankole in the south-west and has no dossier.

Counterparts needing dossiers: british-colonial-empire (eu-11), Mpororo (none). Gazetteer name needed: Isingiro exists as an admin1; Ankole/Nkore as a region.
